subject: Important Update on Your Recent Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We hope this email finds you well. We wanted to inform you about a change in your upcoming flight itinerary. Due to unforeseen circumstances, there has been a schedule change for your flight. Your new departure time is now at 2:00 PM instead of 10:00 AM. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. Please let us know if you have any questions or need further assistance. Thank you for choosing our airline and we look forward to welcoming you on board.
